low_risk_affected_area: local implementation detail change with no boundary, contract, state, persistence, lifecycle, concurrency, or consumer impact

allowed_scores.5: Verified pass: evidence shows no violation and the relevant test, contract, or enforcement boundary is present where applicable
allowed_scores.4: Pass: evidence shows no violation, but enforcement or documentation is incomplete
allowed_scores.3: Warning: localized weakness without boundary, contract, lifecycle, state ownership, or regression breakage
allowed_scores.2: Risk: material architecture risk or missing verification in a medium-risk affected area
allowed_scores.1: Serious risk: localized violation or partial verification of a high-risk affected area
allowed_scores.0: Fail: severe violation, or a high-risk affected area is unverified
allowed_scores.N-A: Not scored: outside review scope and excluded from totals

Encapsulation.5: No exposed internals or leaked mutable state plus verified ownership boundary
Encapsulation.4: No exposed internals but boundary is documented only implicitly
Encapsulation.3: Minor visibility or access concern without consumer impact
Encapsulation.0: Leaked mutable state, public internal implementation dependency, or unverified high-risk ownership boundary

Coupling.5: No new unnecessary dependency and dependency direction verified
Coupling.4: No violation but enforcement is manual
Coupling.2: Material coupling increase without boundary break

Cohesion.5: Each changed unit has one clear responsibility
Cohesion.4: Responsibility is clear but not documented
Cohesion.0: God Class or severe unrelated responsibility aggregation

ExplicitDependencies.5: Dependencies are constructor/config/import visible and contract-based where needed
ExplicitDependencies.0: Service locator/global hidden dependency in affected path

SingleResponsibility.4: Responsibility fit is clear but not documented

DependencyInversion.5: High-level policy depends on contract, not implementation
DependencyInversion.0: High-level policy depends on infrastructure or feature implementation

Testability.5: Deterministic logic and replaceable side effects with relevant tests
Testability.4: Test seam exists but tests/enforcement incomplete
Testability.0: High-risk behavior cannot be tested or verified

BoundaryIntegrity.5: Module/layer/feature boundaries remain intact and verified
BoundaryIntegrity.4: Boundaries intact but not automatically enforced
BoundaryIntegrity.0: Module/layer violation, cycle, or cross-feature internal dependency

ContractCompatibility.5: Public contract unchanged or backward-compatible with tests

StateAndLifecycleOwnership.5: Clear owner and lifecycle with tests or enforcement where relevant
StateAndLifecycleOwnership.0: Leaked state, uncontrolled global mutable state, lifecycle hazard, or unverified high-risk state change

RegressionSafety.5: Affected regression tests or equivalent verification exists
RegressionSafety.4: Test plan exists but is not automated
RegressionSafety.2: Medium-risk change missing direct regression test

AbstractionFit.4: Abstraction fits but lacks documented rationale
AbstractionFit.0: Abstraction hides boundary violation or creates broad coupling

verdict_rules: Any required criterion scored 0 or 1 prevents PASS
Do not average scores unless explicitly requested
